# agentic-video

> agentic-video lets an AI agent that reads text and images, but not video, work with video files on your own machine.

## Docs

- [Where each tool runs](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/capabilities.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): One row per tool (25 in `src/adapters/mcp_schemas.json`). The last three columns say what a tool needs. "yes" means the code needs it; "no" means it does not.
- [Claude Code plugin](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/claude-code-plugin.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): Installs the agentic-video MCP server and its skill into Claude Code in two commands. Install ffmpeg first (`brew install ffmpeg` on macOS, `sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg` on Debian or Ubuntu) and install `uv` so `uvx` is on your PATH. The first run downloads the Python package.
- [Argument shapes](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/argument-shapes.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): What it does: the server reads three wrong shapes whose meaning is certain, and rewrites each to the documented shape before the schema check:
- [Audio onsets](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/audio-onsets.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: the `audio_onsets` tool (`band_hz`, `compare_to`, `min_strength`, `min_gap_sec`).
- [Contact sheets](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/contact-sheets.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: `contact_sheet`, `inspect_window`, `inspect_windows`, `inspect_moments`, `overview_chunks`.
- [Cut detection](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/cut-detection.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: the `detect_cuts` tool, `sync_check`, and `python -m src.loop check` (its cut list).
- [Claude Desktop bundle](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/desktop-bundle.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): What it is: `agentic-video-<version>.mcpb`, a one-click install for Claude Desktop. Double-click the file and Claude Desktop installs the same stdio MCP server that `uvx agentic-video` runs. The tools do not change.
- [Frame at](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/frame-at.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: `frame_at` (source, time_sec, optional crop {x, y, width, height} in source pixels, optional scale 1-4, optional `read_text` boolean, default false).
- [Frame cadence](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/frame-cadence.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: the `check_frame_cadence` tool, and `python -m src.loop cadence <video>` (prints the same JSON).
- [Label sounds](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/label-sounds.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: the `label_sounds` tool, and `python -m src.media.sound_labels VIDEO START END [--labels a,b] [--window-sec N]`.
- [Loudness timeline](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/loudness-timeline.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: the `loudness_timeline` tool, and `python -m src.loop check`.
- [MCP responses](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/mcp-responses.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: any MCP `tools/call` to the stdio server, from any client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Executor, ...).
- [Review video](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/review-video.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: the `review_video` tool.
- [Shadow Cloudflare transcription (trial)](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/shadow-cf-asr.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): This SENDS AUDIO TO CLOUDFLARE. It is a trial switch for the maintainer, on the maintainer's own machines. It is never on by default, and it is not in the public PyPI package's defaults.
- [Transcribe](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/transcribe.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: the `transcribe` and `search_transcript` tools. `search_transcript` is hybrid by default (`mode: hybrid`); `mode: lexical` gives keyword matches only.
- [Watch for](https://github.com/tlq5l/agentic-video/blob/main/docs/llms/features/watch.md?ref=agentic-video-llms-txt-docs-index): How a user reaches it: the `watch_for` tool, and `python -m src.media.watch VIDEO --when "QUESTION" [--when ...] [--start N --end N --interval N --cut N --consecutive N --cooldown N]`.
